compatibility_contract.required_input_construction: Arithmetic mean of the nine raw SIM phase frames from BioSR figshare 13264793 version 9.
compatibility_contract.machine_checkable_scope: Dimensionality, unit, spacing and analysis grid are checked at runtime. Acquisition identity and phase-mean construction remain user-declared and are recorded as unverifiable requirements.

disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.hessian_blob_scale: The high-resolution reference maximum was at a scale-grid boundary, so the scalar was censored rather than identified; retain the curve.
disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.hessian_tube_scale: The high-resolution reference maximum was at a scale-grid boundary, so the scalar was censored rather than identified; retain the curve.
disabled_for_this_acquisition_profile.spectral_scale: Eighty-five of 86 reference-eligible pilot pairs exceeded the frozen 25% relative-error tolerance; retain the calibrated spectrum but do not emit this scalar for this acquisition profile.

limited_support_notes.tensor_orientation: Reference consensus eligibility was 0/270 CCP cases and 30/180 ER cases; all 30 eligible ER cases met the 10-degree error tolerance.
limited_support_notes.tensor_coherence: All 51 observed errors occurred in the two lowest ER signal levels; operating-threshold calibration must demonstrate selective rejection without using signal-level labels at runtime.

unknown_profile_behavior: Measurements are returned as unvalidated unless a compatible acquisition profile or direct perturbation/ground-truth validation is available.
claim_boundary: A development-selected profile awaiting untouched threshold calibration and confirmation; not a universal endorsement of these endpoints.
